title: Dust ring / Perfected Warder of Earth
summary: Clear the dust temple to release the Triumvirate of Soil and the Perfected Warder of Earth.
overview: Clear the dust temple to release the Triumvirate of Soil and the Perfected Warder of Earth.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Defeat all thirty-two Dust Devotees to activate the three members of the Triumvirate of Soil.
Defeat the Triumvirate to summon the Warder, or a Dust Follower if the main encounter is on cooldown.
The Warder randomly uses one of three setups: additional Soil enemies, repeated groups of three to six protectors, or no added wave.
The boss can clear hate every twelve seconds. Have tanks ready for both a target reset and a new protector group.
The overall event allows three hours, while the final boss has a fifty-minute hard despawn.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
